name: Rizuhble's Happy Little Splats
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting bursted in lane. Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,000 (levels 1-14). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Abstract Landscape unlocked. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Surge of Power. Ultimate (Abstract Landscape) is available from Surge of Power.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 14 to Still Life's damage (1.40x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Lifesteal, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Living Ink (2 to 3).

items.name: Mystic Regeneration
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Surge of Power completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Surge of Power completes 4.8k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Surge of Power
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Living Ink: +28 spirit on that ability only, about +19.6 on its damage (0.70x scaling). Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Lifesteal, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Healing Booster
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Spirit Lifesteal completes 2,400 souls on. Upgrade of Extra Regen (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Spirit Lifesteal completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Spirit Shielding
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Spirit Lifesteal completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Grit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Spirit Lifesteal completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,000-21,600 (levels 14-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Living Ink T3, Still Life T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Flow State, max damage) grows from 194 to 299. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Spirit Lifesteal.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 32.4 to Flow State's max damage (1.80x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Flow State (260), Still Life (184) clear its 80-damage trigger.

items.name: Radiant Regeneration
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 7,200 to 9,600 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Living Ink (3 to 4). Takes spirit from 9,600 to 12,000 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Still Life: takes 18% off its 35s base cooldown.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: component_for)

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Flow State (313) clears its 165-damage trigger. Takes spirit from 15,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,000-46,400 (levels 27-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Flow State T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Flow State, max damage) grows from 313 to 459.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 204s; 20% off is 40.8s per full rotation.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 19,200 to 24,000 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 54 to Flow State's max damage (1.80x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 24,000 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Infuser
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Grit? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Spirit Shielding.
sections.desc: Dying after Grit? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Spirit Shielding.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Spirit damage that keeps hurting you after the hit: Infernus, Seven, Vyper, Lady Geist.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Knockdown, Slowing Hex, Disarming Hex and slows.

items.name: Knockdown
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Flyers like Vindicta and Grey Talon keep getting away.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Abstract Landscape gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (145s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Takes vitality from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Living Ink hits shorten your ult too, so it comes up often. Sell Enchanter's Emblem for this.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (0 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 0 to 54% weapon damage. Replaces Tankbuster: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 204s of base cooldown across your kit, 145s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Radiant Regeneration: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
